model.generation_seed: replicate index, identical across all a/b cases and matched conditions
model.unsupported_setting: A049 amendment: vLLM0.11.0 ignores parallel_tool_calls; accepted explicitly. Send false and reject all responses other than exactly one valid call before native execution. No generation-level guarantee.
model.transport_finish_reason_contract: existing route-scoped stop allowed with exactly one well-formed permitted call; reject length/filter/missing/unknown

acceptance: Stop entire diagnostic on first invalid response or HTTP/route/budget/integrity error. Incorrect but valid answers continue. No tool returned by the model executes any external or task mutation.
text_acceptance: Exactly one choice, model matches, finish_reason stop, content stripped of surrounding whitespace is0or1, no tool call/refusal. Raw response retained.
tool_acceptance: Route-scoped stop or tool_calls with exactly one offered schema-valid function; no splitting/repair/retry. A049 ignored-parallel-setting contract retained, no generation guarantee.

mode_definitions.xor_text: Both bits directly supplied; explicit truth table; reply as text bit.
mode_definitions.xor_tool: Same directly supplied bits and truth-table system; use report_xor(answer string0/1). Response-format instruction differs from text mode.
mode_definitions.allocation_oracle: Replicate1 original allocation wire request, unchanged except an appended explicit correct answer and instruction to choose it. Original receipts/history/payoffs/tools retained.

analysis: Report all12cases by mode, invalid/valid/correct and returned values. Descriptive only. Different contexts/formats/scaffolds mean no isolated causal mechanism or iid inference. No prevention, broad model incompetence or deliberate refusal claim.

interpretation.text_pass_tool_fail: Format/tool-path sensitivity candidate, not universal XOR inability.
interpretation.direct_pass_oracle_fail: Original allocation context/instruction sensitivity candidate, not a proven internal motive.
interpretation.all_pass: Minimal capabilities and explicit-oracle instruction can work; original unassisted composition failed. Does not identify the one causal feature.
interpretation.all_fail: Route-wide/task/format issue remains; no reliable receiver established. Do not proceed main.
interpretation.oracle_pass: Can emit correct allocation when supplied explicitly; does not show unassisted XOR computation.
